food-allergen-chart.title: Free UK Takeaway 14 Food Allergen Chart Matrix
food-allergen-chart.desc: Create and print a compliant 14-allergen chart for your UK food business. Free interactive menu matrix, customer filter, and instant A4 PDF export.
howTo: Replace the example dishes with your own menu and ingredients.
Mark Contains (YES) for every declared ingredient. Use May contain (MAY) only after a cross-contact risk assessment.
Check every dish against your recipes and supplier specifications, and update the chart whenever a recipe, product or supplier changes.
Keep the chart where staff can find it and make sure staff can explain it to customers.

allergy-matrix.title: Free 14 Allergen Matrix Tool for UK Restaurants
allergy-matrix.desc: Map all 14 statutory allergens across your commercial menu. Filter ingredients interactively and export an ink-friendly A4 kitchen poster in seconds.
howTo: Enter dish titles alongside full recipe specifications and ingredient packages.
Flag declared allergens and identify cross-contact risks across prep lines.
Print or export your matrix to keep staff and customers safely informed.

food-cost-calculator.title: Free Food Cost Percentage Calculator for UK Kitchens
food-cost-calculator.desc: Calculate recipe food cost percentages, gross margins, and profitable takeaway menu prices with our free interactive commercial kitchen calculator.
howTo: Input ingredient purchase prices and exact recipe portion weights.
Review target gross profit percentage against total dish production cost.
Set profitable takeaway menu prices while tracking ingredient inflation.

recipe-calculator.title: Commercial Recipe Scaling Calculator | Batch Yields
recipe-calculator.desc: Scale commercial catering recipes from 10 to 500 portions accurately. Calculate exact batch ingredient weights and kitchen production costs for free.
howTo: Enter standard batch recipe ingredients, baseline quantities, and units.
Select your target scaling factor or required guest portion headcount.
Print updated kitchen production sheets with scaled ingredient measurements.

haccp-plan-builder.title: Free UK Takeaway HACCP Plan Builder & CCP Matrix
haccp-plan-builder.desc: Build a compliant commercial kitchen HACCP plan online. Identify critical control points, set control limits, and print structured kitchen logs to PDF.
howTo: Map out each stage of food preparation from delivery to final hot service.
Establish critical limits for cooking, cooling, and refrigeration steps.
Document corrective actions for staff when critical limits are breached.

food-safety-quiz.title: UK Food Hygiene Level 2 Practice Exam & Quiz Tool
food-safety-quiz.desc: Test your kitchen team with this interactive UK Food Hygiene Level 2 quiz. Review temperature rules, cross-contamination, and Natasha's Law online.
howTo: Complete the multiple-choice assessment covering core UK hygiene standards.
Review detailed explanations on cold holding, reheating, and sanitiser rules.
Retake the quiz during staff onboarding to reinforce kitchen compliance.

freezer-temperature-chart.title: Free Freezer & Fridge Temperature Log Sheet (PDF)
freezer-temperature-chart.desc: Download free dual-shift commercial fridge and freezer temperature logs. Keep your kitchen aligned with UK Food Standards Agency due diligence rules.
howTo: Mount this chart directly onto or adjacent to commercial walk-in freezers.
Record morning and evening internal temperature readings twice per shift.
Take corrective action immediately if freezer temperatures rise above -18°C.

food-cooling-poster.title: Commercial Food Cooling 90-Minute Guide Poster
food-cooling-poster.desc: Download a free kitchen wall poster explaining the UK 90-minute cooling rule, blast chilling, and danger zone temperature limits for safe catering.
howTo: Divide hot cooked batches into shallow stainless steel pans before chilling.
Cool food to 8°C or colder within 90 minutes to prevent spore germination.
Cover, date-code, and transfer chilled containers into cold storage promptly.

basic-food-preparation-rules.title: Basic Food Hygiene & Safe Prep Rules Poster (UK)
basic-food-preparation-rules.desc: Printable food preparation hygiene poster for commercial kitchens. Essential due diligence guidelines covering hand hygiene, cross-contamination, and cooking.
howTo: Display clearly above food preparation tables and vegetable washing sinks.
Train kitchen staff to wash hands thoroughly between handling different foods.
Use clean, sanitized equipment for every new food preparation task.

walk-in-cooler-food-storage-chart.title: Commercial Walk-In Chiller Food Storage Layout Chart
walk-in-cooler-food-storage-chart.desc: Visual food storage shelf chart for commercial walk-in chillers. Prevent drip cross-contamination by organizing raw poultry, meats, and ready-to-eat foods.
howTo: Store ready-to-eat foods, dairy, and cooked dishes on the highest shelving.
Place raw beef, pork, and seafood on middle shelves below prepared items.
Keep raw poultry on bottom shelves to prevent juices dripping onto other foods.

fridge-temperature-record-sheet-pdf.title: Commercial Fridge Temperature Record Sheet UK (PDF)
fridge-temperature-record-sheet-pdf.desc: Print daily commercial fridge temperature monitoring sheets for UK restaurants. Record morning prep and evening service checks for EHO inspections.
howTo: Check calibrated fridge thermometers at opening and during the afternoon shift.
Record temperature readings alongside staff initials on the log sheet daily.
Report chiller units exceeding 8°C to the duty manager for urgent service.

cleaning-schedule.title: Commercial Kitchen Cleaning Schedule Template UK
cleaning-schedule.desc: Download a free commercial kitchen cleaning rota covering daily, weekly, and deep-clean tasks. Ready to print and display for council inspections.
howTo: Assign specific kitchen cleaning zones to team members on each shift rota.
Specify approved sanitiser contact times and dilution ratios (BS EN 1276).
Sign and date completion logs after each deep clean or shift handover.

restaurant-cleaning-checklist.title: Commercial Restaurant Deep Cleaning Checklist (UK)
restaurant-cleaning-checklist.desc: Comprehensive daily, weekly, and monthly cleaning checklist for UK commercial restaurant kitchens. Audit extraction canopies, grease traps, and line equipment.
howTo: Complete opening sanitising passes on all food contact surfaces and counters.
Perform mid-shift sanitiser sweeps on high-touch touchpoints and door handles.
Sign off kitchen closing cleaning routines including grease traps and floors.

opening-and-closing-checklist-template.title: Kitchen Opening & Closing Checklist Template UK
opening-and-closing-checklist-template.desc: Free printable opening and closing hygiene checklist for UK food businesses. Maintain SFBB standards across food storage, safety, and kitchen locks.
howTo: Inspect chillers, pilot lights, and ventilation hoods upon arrival on shift.
Verify sanitizer spray concentrations and handwashing soap basin stocks.
Complete evening shutdown checks, lock store cupboards, and verify waste bins.

kitchen-prep-list-template.title: Commercial Kitchen Daily Food Prep List Template
kitchen-prep-list-template.desc: Organise daily kitchen production with this commercial prep sheet. Track batch pars, prep quantities, FIFO rotation, and morning line readiness.
howTo: Review forecast covers and record required batch quantities by station.
Assign prep responsibilities to station chefs before service begins.
Label all prepped containers with ingredient names and use-by date dots.

pest-control-checklist.title: Commercial Kitchen Pest Control Inspection Checklist
pest-control-checklist.desc: Routine pest prevention and monitoring checklist for UK commercial caterers. Inspect bait stations, building proofing, and waste storage areas daily.
howTo: Inspect external doors, pipe penetrations, and ventilation screens weekly.
Check storage areas and dry pantries for any signs of pest activity or droppings.
Log contractor inspection visits and file pest technician reports on site.

food-traceability.title: UK Commercial Food Traceability Log Sheet Template
food-traceability.desc: Document one-step-back and one-step-forward ingredient traceability for UK food businesses. Record delivery batch codes, invoices, and use-by dates.
howTo: Record delivery dates, supplier names, and batch codes for incoming meats.
Log batch lot numbers when opening bulk packages for recipe preparation.
Retain supplier records for full one-step-back and one-step-forward tracking.

food-recall.title: Food Recall & Product Withdrawal Procedure Log (UK)
food-recall.desc: Standard operating procedure and customer notification log for food product recalls and withdrawals under UK Food Standards Agency regulations.
howTo: Identify affected batch numbers and isolate suspect stock in quarantine.
Document communication with suppliers, customers, and regulatory authorities.
Complete a root-cause investigation before closing the recall incident log.

hand-washing-poster.title: Commercial Kitchen Hand Washing Steps Poster (UK)
hand-washing-poster.desc: Printable 6-step hand washing technique poster for food handlers. Aligned with UK Food Standards Agency hygiene rules for commercial kitchen washbasins.
howTo: Position directly above all dedicated staff handwash basins in the kitchen.
Instruct staff to lather antibacterial soap vigorously for at least 20 seconds.
Dry hands thoroughly with disposable blue paper roll; never use apron towels.

kitchen-safety-poster.title: Commercial Kitchen Health & Safety Rules Poster UK
kitchen-safety-poster.desc: Essential health and safety guidelines for commercial kitchen staff. Covers hot oil handling, slip hazards, knife safety, and emergency protocols.
howTo: Mount in main kitchen thoroughfares near cooking lines and wash-up zones.
Review emergency fire blanket and first-aid kit locations with new team members.
Ensure staff wear slip-resistant safety shoes and correct protective aprons.

reheating-food-temperature-guide.title: Food Reheating Temperature Guide UK Kitchens (PDF)
reheating-food-temperature-guide.desc: Learn safe reheating rules for UK catering kitchens. Ensure hot core temperatures reach 75°C to destroy pathogens and pass local authority audits.
howTo: Reheat pre-cooked foods rapidly until core temperature reaches at least 75°C.
Stir soups, gravies, and stews during reheating to distribute heat evenly.
Never reheat food more than once; discard leftovers that are not consumed.

five-food-safety-rules.title: WHO 5 Keys to Safer Food Kitchen Poster & Guide
five-food-safety-rules.desc: World Health Organisation 5 keys to safer food reference poster for staff training. Covers cleanliness, separation, cooking, temperature, and safe water.
howTo: Display prominently in staff breakrooms and near food preparation stations.
Use as a visual teaching aid during new employee hygiene onboarding sessions.
Reinforce daily standards for temperature control, cleaning, and sanitising.

chopping-board-colour-chart.title: Colour Coded Chopping Board Chart UK Kitchens (PDF)
chopping-board-colour-chart.desc: Printable colour-coded cutting board wall poster for UK food businesses. Prevent cross-contamination between raw meat, poultry, fish, and salads.
howTo: Mount above chopping board storage racks in the main preparation kitchen.
Use red boards for raw meat, yellow for cooked meat, and green for salad.
Sanitise cutting boards through commercial dishwashers after each usage.

hot-holding-food-temperature-log.title: Commercial Hot Holding Temperature Log Sheet UK
hot-holding-food-temperature-log.desc: Record hot-held food temperatures above 63°C throughout service. Free printable log sheet meeting UK Food Standards Agency hot holding requirements.
howTo: Preheat bain-maries and hot holding wells before loading hot cooked dishes.
Probe and log food temperatures every 2 hours to ensure they remain above 63°C.
Discard hot food displayed below 63°C after a maximum of 2 hours.
